items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of tree-felling permit
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Behörde: Landkreis Musterpeene, Kreishausweg 1, 17109 Musterdemmin.
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 19.11.2026, sent by ordinary mail (einfacher Brief). Per the rule stated in the letter (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG M-V), it is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting: 19.11 is day 0, so day 1=20.11 (Fri), day 2=21.11 (Sat), day 3=22.11 (Sun), day 4=23.11 (Mon) => Bekanntgabe (deemed notification) = 23.11.2026, a working day (no holiday adjustment needed since it's just the notification fiction, not a deadline end). The one-month objection period then starts the following day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB): 24.11.2026. Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, a one-month period ends on the day of the last month bearing the same number as the day of the triggering event (23), i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). This is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in MV, so no shift under § 193 BGB applies. Final deadline: 23.12.2026.

warnings: The letter states that an ordinary-mail decision 'gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben' (deemed delivered on the 4th day); the standard wording in most German VwVfG statutes (including the federal § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG) is the third day, not the fourth — worth double-checking the exact current wording of § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG M-V, though the computed deadline here used the letter's stated rule.

No explicit posting date (Aufgabe zur Post) is given separately from the letter's date of 19.11.2026; the delivery-fiction calculation assumes posting occurred on that same day, which is the usual but not certain assumption.
